research_informed_by: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.12045 — τ-bench: multi-turn tool-agent-user interaction, task-state correctness, and policy adherence.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04682 — ToolSandbox: stateful multi-turn tool execution, implicit dependencies, and trajectory-level evaluation.
https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-demo.16/ — RAGAs: separate retrieval relevance, generation faithfulness, and answer quality; judge metrics are not ground truth.
scope: Text only; local API; active runtime catalog plus full dataset validation metadata

rubric: sounds natural in Vietnamese and fits the user's register
does not repeat unnecessary product details
asks a short clarification when the target is ambiguous
